name: Shroud of Absence (Dominate + Obtenebration, Combination Discipline)

system.description:
A refinement of Shroud of Night, this combination power creates a region into which nobody looks or thinks to linger, rather than a visible cloud of blackness. Spend a Blood Trait to create a blind spot roughly ten feet across that moves at your walking speed. Anyone wishing to see inside the Shroud must defeat you in a Willpower Challenge.

System (MET): Static Social Challenge against seven Traits to create the Shroud. Anyone seeking to peer inside must win a Willpower Challenge against you, its creator (you may spend Social Traits to raise your Willpower total for this purpose).
system.duration: Until dismissed or the creator moves out of range
